acceptance.candidateRule: A new language mechanism needs a reproduced baseline failure or a material agent benefit that persists on held-out cases; if five attempts do not distinguish it, retain the simpler current design and record the unresolved hypothesis.
acceptance.gate: Gate 1/2 core contract integration (T09) and later gates are reproducible only against this frozen baseline plus explicitly recorded changes.
acceptance.pilotRule: A preliminary pilot may debug the harness but cannot be counted in the five attempts and no language mechanism is credited by a pilot.
acceptance.success: All positive, negative, refactor and observable product checks passing with no hidden semantic widening or unauthorized effect; five-attempt success counts and uncertainty reported.

compiler.revisionNote: T01 baseline commit; later revisions must record the delta explicitly. Ancestor-of-HEAD is asserted, not equality, so later task commits keep this file valid.

commands: test -z "$(gofmt -l compiler/ tests/ tools/ distribution/ internal/)"
coreRegression.mirror: CI workflow .github/workflows/verifier.yml (target qualification); run.sh --full executes this list in a disposable directory.

services.browser: pinned Playwright Chromium via tests/integration/browser (bun ci + playwright install chromium)
services.bunArchive: pinned upstream zip from distribution/target.json upstream.url; sha256 90987a3a16d7db556d886ac3d551e7b6d3edf0a1cf43acaed622e8676be1d12f
services.typescript: pinned leg via tscheck (bun ci; CAN_TSC)

disposableDirs.build: mktemp -d (canlc binary, bundles, reports); removed on exit unless KEEP_DIR=1
disposableDirs.policy: No build artifact, bundle or report is written into the source tree. Every harness run uses a fresh disposable directory; trial attempts additionally require fresh workspace state (see registry trial settings).
disposableDirs.trialAttempt: fresh checkout/worktree per attempt; no access to another attempt's transcript
